text.4_Chapter, 1_Halakhah, 0_Comment: "And they would use silver vessels, etc." — Referring to Tzadok, Boethus, and their students. But in the book Binyan Yehoshua, it says this refers to Antigonus and his students — this seems to be an incidental slip.
text.4_Chapter, 1_Halakhah, 1_Comment: "And two breaches emerged from them" — Rambam explains this well in his commentary on the Mishnah. See also Tzemach David, Part 1, Section 3, on this topic.

work: Kisse Rahamim on Avot D'Rabbi Natan
